description: How often each J2 evidence type is expected, per site or other scope. The evidence types themselves and which questions trigger them are NOT defined here - they come from reference-data/config/libraries/evidence_type_library.json and the evidence_triggered lists in intake/config/profile_schema.json. This file adds only the one thing neither of those states: cadence.
sourcing_note: intake/profile_schema_mapping.md states a cadence exactly once - section 6.1, 'J2-002 x12 months per meter'. That is the only entry here marked non-provisional. Every other cadence is an assumption about how a client's records are kept, not a methodology fact, so it ships as 'as_available' flagged provisional for Todd rather than invented. A provisional cadence still produces a correct request; it just does not claim to know how many documents to expect.

as_available.label: as many as exist for the reporting year
as_available.note: One open request covering the whole period. The expected count is unknown, so the completeness spec reports it as unknown rather than guessing a number.

J2-001.reason: Gas utility bills are usually monthly, but nothing in the mapping or the workbooks says so. Assuming monthly would make the completeness gate fail every client billed quarterly.

J2-002.source: intake/profile_schema_mapping.md section 6.1: 'J2-002 x12 months per meter'

J2-003.reason: Fuel deliveries happen when a tank runs low, not on a calendar. There is no defensible expected count.

J2-004.reason: Fuel-card statements are typically monthly per card, but the card count is not collected today and the mapping is silent.

J2-005.reason: Generator runtime logs are kept per generator in whatever form the site keeps them.

J2-006.reason: Refrigerant service records exist only when a unit was serviced. Expecting a fixed number would flag well-maintained sites as incomplete.

J2-007.reason: A facility register or lease describes the reporting period as a whole; one per scope is the natural unit, but the mapping does not say so.

J2-008.reason: An equipment list or air permit is a point-in-time document covering the period.

J2-009.reason: Meter and submeter logs vary by site; some are continuous exports, some monthly reads.

J2-012.reason: Wastewater records only exist where there is on-site treatment, which is itself a human-reviewed case.

J2-014.reason: One prior-year report per prior year; the number of prior years is not collected today.

J2-019.reason: Certificates and contracts are issued per purchase, not per period.
